name: Computer Use
description: Gives the chat agent screenshot, click, type, and scroll on the Windows desktop. No workbench UI — Enable it, then ask Anya.

agent.prompt: When the user wants to see or operate the desktop, you MUST use these tools. Priority: (1) launch an app/file/URI (2) key chords (3) click_control / set_value from the UIA list attached to screenshot (4) pixel click/drag only for canvas. Follow the Windows playbook below. SPEED: launch or screenshot once, then emit ALL remaining tools in ONE turn. Screenshot again only after the whole task or if after_pointer says you hit Anya. Do not hover. Do not Win+R if launch works. click: tap; count:2 double-click. drag x,y+x2,y2 is a straight line; curves: path or cx,cy,r. key supports win. Do not click Anya unless asked.
